name: SAP ERP / GTS / S4HANA
headline: One connected backbone for finance, supply chain and trade.
intro: SAP consulting, implementation and support, from ERP rollouts and S/4HANA migration to Global Trade Services, configured around how your business really operates.

overview.what: Our SAP practice covers ERP implementation, S/4HANA migration, Global Trade Services (GTS) for customs and trade compliance, functional configuration, custom development, integrations and ongoing application support.
overview.why: As companies grow, finance, procurement, production, inventory, sales and compliance spread across disconnected tools. A single ERP gives one version of the truth, tighter controls and the reporting needed to run the business with confidence.
problems: Separate systems for finance, stock and sales that never quite reconcile
Month-end closing that depends on manual spreadsheets
Customs, export and licence checks handled manually, with compliance risk
Ageing SAP ECC systems approaching the end of mainstream maintenance
overview.approach: We follow the standard wherever it fits, extend only where the business case is clear, and run implementations as a joint effort with your process owners, with disciplined testing, data migration and user training.

deliver.d: End-to-end rollout of SAP modules with business-blueprint, configuration and go-live support.
Assessment, roadmap and conversion or greenfield implementation from legacy SAP landscapes.
Customs management, sanctioned-party screening, preference handling and trade compliance.
Finance, procurement, sales, inventory and production processes configured to your needs.
ABAP extensions, Fiori apps and interfaces to third-party and legacy systems.
Incident handling, enhancements, patching and user assistance after go-live.

capabilities.d: General ledger, accounts payable and receivable, asset accounting, cost centres and statutory reporting.
Purchase requisitions through goods receipt, invoice verification and stock management.
Quotation to cash, pricing, delivery, billing and credit management.
Production orders, bills of materials, material requirements planning and shop-floor confirmation.
Export and import documentation, restricted-party checks and licence determination through GTS.
Embedded analytics, Fiori dashboards and data extraction for wider business intelligence.

process.d: We understand your processes, entities, volumes and pain points, and define scope.
Requirements are mapped to SAP standard, with gaps and extensions justified.
Modules, interfaces and reports are configured and developed in agreed phases.
Master and transactional data is cleansed, loaded and reconciled alongside integration and user testing.
Key users are trained, cutover is rehearsed and the system goes live with hypercare.
Ongoing support, enhancements and periodic process reviews.

benefits.d: Finance, operations and compliance work from the same real-time data.
Automated postings and reconciliations shorten reporting cycles.
Automated screening and documentation reduce trade and audit exposure.
Visibility across procurement, stock and billing supports tighter working capital.
S/4HANA positions the business for modern analytics and automation.

usecases.d: Migration to S/4HANA with simplified processes and Fiori user experience.
GTS automates customs documents and screens trading partners.
Unified procurement, inventory and billing replace disconnected tools.
Consolidated finance and intercompany processes across legal entities.

cta.h: Plan your SAP journey with a team that has done it before.
cta.p: Whether it is a new implementation, an S/4HANA move or a trade compliance need, start with a conversation about where you are today.
